name: mage
description: a Mage (Fall from Heaven), a bearded wizard: brown hair and a full brown beard, a tall floppy pointed royal-blue hat with gold stars and a gold band, a long royal-blue robe with gold stars and gold trim, a brown leather belt with a gold buckle and a small brown pouch, brown boots, and a gnarled wooden staff topped with a glowing white-blue orb in his LEFT hand; his RIGHT hand is open, palm up, in a casting gesture
hands: the orb-topped staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty open hand held up at chest height on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, the tall pointed hat jolting, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty open right hand flung out to the left, the orb-topped staff thrown up and out in his left hand)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the orb-topped staff tilting back, his empty right hand still held out, the hat tip flopping

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the orb-topped staff high, his empty right hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops under the pointed hat, the orb-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the staff slanting down with its orb end resting on the ground at the lower-right, his empty right hand hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the orb-topped staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the blue robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the pointed blue hat still on his head; the orb-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the starry robe spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the blue robe and the hat tip settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the orb-topped staff on the ground beside him
